text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the Board of Management of the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending May 31, 2023 and until successors are appointed: Jamie Anderson Rob Hamilton Ann Morton William Roberts Kosta Roumanis Jack Slaughter
